title: City Election Certified, Run-off Prepared
summary:
*   **Election Results Certified:** The May 7th General Municipal Election results were officially reviewed and approved.
*   **Run-off Election Ordinance:** An emergency ordinance was passed to call for a run-off election, if required, based on the outcomes of the general election.
*   **Brief Session:** The special meeting was very short, concluding after just 17 minutes, with both actions focused on the municipal election logistics.
